facts.fact: Landing-page research cited by the page reports that nearly half of website visitors never get beyond the primary landing page (a third-party claim from penguindesigning.com, not AdWave's own data).
facts.quote: Landing-page research reports that nearly half of website visitors never get beyond the primary landing page

facts.fact: Lead-gen guidance cited by the page (Conway Marketing Group, a third-party source) says shorter forms often improve completion rates, while multi-step forms and CRM integration can improve lead qualification.
facts.quote: Shorter forms often improve completion rates, while multi-step forms and CRM integration can improve lead qualification by collecting more details later in the funnel

facts.fact: The page advises a rule of collecting less information upfront, qualifying leads through follow-up, and tightening the form only when low-quality volume becomes a real operational problem.
facts.quote: collect less upfront, qualify through follow-up, and tighten the form only when low-quality volume becomes a real operational problem.

facts.fact: The page recommends starting contact page measurement with one metric: completed form submissions, tracked as a conversion event in analytics.
facts.quote: Start with one measurement: completed form submissions.

facts.fact: The page recommends reviewing four items monthly once submission tracking is in place: traffic sources producing inquiries, device performance, pages that send visitors to the contact page, and form starts versus completed submissions.
facts.quote: Once submission tracking is in place, look at four things during your monthly review:

facts.fact: The page advises changing one meaningful element at a time and giving each test enough time to produce a pattern.
facts.quote: Change one meaningful element at a time and give it enough time to produce a pattern.

facts.fact: The page describes Adwave, its vendor, as one option SMBs use to launch TV campaigns with targeting and measurement in one platform.
facts.quote: Adwave is one option SMBs use to launch TV campaigns with targeting and measurement in one platform.
